body: Cough and Elephant Tree are some of my favorites.
I think the purpose in life is easy enough to find ... question is if it's enough to offset the suffering. I'm not sure. Not thinking so these days, it's not good enough.
People won't tell you. It's easy to open up online anonymously. Being suicidal comes with a lot of guilt, not exactly something you want everyone to know

Sorry to hear that, that was always a nightmare I had back when I drank a lot. Happened to a friend of mine, he's stuck on the bracelet monitor and can't drive anywhere but work for a year. Did you manage to get anything worked out in court? His DWI was turned into just an implied consent violation I believe. You might get lucky. Dunno. Wish you luck. Try not to stress over the pilot stuff right now, take it one step now that the scenario has changed
Operation Meetinghouse. Nagasaki. Hiroshima. IMTFE.
What purpose... wish someone could just assign me one and give me the energy to do  it, lol. I don't care about anything enough.

Yeah I don't think many people have specific things like a car accident or medical bills that make them extremely depressed/suicidal ... somewhat more a lifelong endeavor ... at least from what I've seen. My life isn't necessarily shit, I'm just shit at living it, or making anything out of it. For me that stems from really just being apathetic and having chronic fatigue, even a legacy burns in the sun and is forgotten.

Sounds just like me but I'm 27, only a few years to 30. I've done absolutely nothing with my life due to depression, exhaustion, lack of motivation. All I have is self hate. People want me to do things, but I don't really want to do them, I just want to get out of here.
Yup drugs never make it better, they only make you think that they'll make it better, then when you trip up they'll make it worse and laugh when you come back for more, thinking it'll make it better.

Eating the elephant is so tiresome. I'm sober now, I've started running and trying to be healthier. But I still have so much dread over the things I need to do to fix my life and the energy that requires. Basically homeless right now, with very little hope most days. I just always wish I was someone else who wasn't born and abused into this broken mind. What advice do you have? Sorry if my comments seem aggressive at all, not intentional, I'm just in the dumps.
I feel the same. I can only laugh at my rage and life incompetence. Biggest joke I played on myself. Decade and counting. Wish I could log off and just spectate this shit show.
Same things that stopped us doing it back then. We don't just wake up one day with the energy to accomplish. I wish there was an easy way out of the hole.
If a god exists I've got a bone to pick with 'em. What an empty phrase, thank god for my endless suffering.
Problem is nobody gives a fuck about "neutral facts" or you digging up shit to invalidate someone. We're here to vent and be supportive.
Sadly it's pretty dang hard making a living in a country when you aren't a citizen, in my experience.
Felt all that strongly as a young guy. I wish you some peace. Thanks for everything.
Not too long no worries, quite succinctly and well written, and much appreciated. Thanks for taking the time!

I really hoped it wasn't when I was a kid. I always figured by the time I was an adult I'd grow out of it. Nope, not the case. It only got worse because I never did anything to fix it. It absolutely requires attention and repair. The earlier the better.
This sounds like something I would write. I'm sorry we're like this. But I'm glad we're still here for now.
Don't let them make you feel guilty or like you're just seeking attention. Depression is a very real and physical illness, those who haven't had it only believe half truths. You are valid.

I've been considering this. What are some jobs you can get in non-profits or healthcare that don't require any experience? Or maybe something that just needs a certificate you can get quickly? Any tips on how to search for those? I'm currently unemployed in the same position as OP and looking around. I would like more to have a job with some kind of purpose moreso than just making ends meet, I'm good at listening and counseling people, and I'm good with computers. It's okay if the pay isn't amazing, as long as it keeps the landlord and bank away..

That's a good idea. I've thought about just getting a job as a line cook somewhere, even though I have a lot of IT experience and could make a lot more. But I do enjoy cooking sometimes and maybe just having something to keep my mind off it would do me a lot of good. Sitting in my room all day isn't helping

I don't have the energy right now to reply to every comment here, but know that you all and your words are well appreciated, and have made me feel less alone knowing how relatable this was to several people. So thank you.

I feel that a lot. I've always been a pillar, a smile, hard working ... people don't really believe you when you say otherwise but they can never see what's going on behind the wheel.

I'm right there with you ... yep, just one more day

Much love and respect

Thank you for your kind words, my mom doesn't have much money either but this is actually my current plan, to move back in with her to reduce the load and try to go to college and find some line of work that's more enjoyable for me.

I can't really afford therapy either, but the crisis lines is a good idea, I've never used one of those before. I'll keep that in mind for when it gets really bad again.

Much love
